verification.method: scripts/verify/telecom-114.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; check-wdi.mjs compares all 129,951 generated WDI values with the original files; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every ranking row (182 economies, order and value), the CSV, every figure in the text, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: the three economies at 100% and Denmark fourth, Burundi and Uganda the only ones under 10%, eleven under 20%, 55 at 90% or more, world share above half since 2019, regional and income-group shares, first year above half for Bangladesh, India and Pakistan; definition from the World Bank indicator notes
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and indicator metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0; original source ITU World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database)
verification.result: All automated comparisons matched; before publishing the ranking year was set by country coverage (2024 for internet use, 2023 for mobile) because the World Bank's world estimates run a year or two ahead of country data, and 'phones per person' was changed to 'subscriptions per person'

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI (ITU) internet users for 2024.
